faqs.q: How do I know if I need a repair or a full replacement?
faqs.a: It depends on the age, condition and extent of the damage. An assessment shows whether a targeted repair makes sense or whether replacement is the better long-term value, and you get the reasoning in writing.

faqs.q: What happens during a roof assessment?
faqs.a: We inspect the roof surface, flashing, vents and visible decking, take photos, and walk you through the findings. You then receive a written estimate for any recommended work.

faqs.q: How long does a roof replacement take?
faqs.a: Timelines depend on roof size, materials and weather. Your estimate includes the expected schedule so you can plan around it.

faqs.q: Can you help with storm or hail damage and insurance?
faqs.a: We can inspect and document damage with photos to support your claim. Coverage decisions are made by your insurance company.

faqs.q: What warranties come with the work?
faqs.a: Warranty terms depend on the materials selected and the workmanship covered. Details are provided in your written estimate before you decide.
